nonGoals: No water, not even a placeholder plane (02-water owns sea level rendering)
No trees, rocks, props, or any Meshy asset

No biomes, weather, day/night, or terrain editing

No prints below sea level
No depth in the sand - a decal, not deformed geometry

nonGoals: No swimming logic - the player decides that from the terrain height
No foam, spray, or breaking waves at the shore
No reflection or refraction of the world
No underwater fog or colour grading when the camera goes under
No buoyancy for anything else
No ownership of the tide - 00-core owns it; this module only draws at it

modules.title: Background playlist with a panel to skip, rewind, pause and set the volume

Manifest scanned from the folder, fetched at runtime
Audio element, autoplay policy, panel

nonGoals: No positional or diegetic audio - this is background music, not a sound in the world
No sound effects - 08-audio owns those
No ducking, crossfading, or reacting to anything on screen
No shuffle, repeat-one, or a visible queue
No seeking within a track - the bar is a readout, not a scrubber
No metadata beyond what the filename says; no ID3 parsing
No streaming from anywhere but the assets folder

modules.title: Sky dome with sun, stars and cloud, and four weathers you can pick

blocks.title: Dome sizing, cloud projection, cover threshold
Gradient, sun, stars and cloud in one shader
Rain and snow as one GPU-animated instanced system
Contract, tests, MODULE.md

nonGoals: No ownership of the weather or the light - 00-core owns both; this draws them
No simulated weather: it is chosen, never a front moving across the island
No accumulation - snow does not settle and rain does not wet anything
No lightning, thunder, wind on the vegetation, or any sound
No volumetric cloud, god rays, or anything needing a second pass
No moon; night is stars and a dark gradient
No effect on the water surface or the footprints

modules.title: Shells and coloured pebbles scattered along the water line

nonGoals: No collision - you walk through them
No picking up, kicking, or any interaction at all
No movement with the tide; placed once and never washed about
No models - every shape is geometry and none of it goes near the loader
No seaweed, driftwood, crabs or anything that is not a shell or a pebble
No change to the terrain they sit on

No ambience: wind, surf and birds are a soundscape, not a cue
No sounds for the water, the weather, the shore or the UI
No sound for remote players in a lobby
No variation packs; one file per cue, pitched about
No ducking against the music

nonGoals: No authority - the relay passes on what it is told and validates nothing
No persistence; rooms exist only while somebody is in them

No voice and no chat
